population: Per-cell three alternating measured pairs after one warmup/variant; summaries and repeated verification records are not observations. No cross-cell/runtime pooling.

clocks.native-linux: GNU time wrapper launch through CLI exit including snapshot/publication/product cleanup; verification/generation excluded.
clocks.wasi-chromium: After defaults/pickers through prepare, confirmation, export/marker/session retirement in persistent Chromium; collection/verification/browser startup excluded. Same profiling overhead both variants.

scope_notes: Linux is WSL2, warm uncontrolled ext4/OPFS; no physical-device/native-Windows performance claim.
Working reservations are not RSS. Native Analysis temporary counters precede publication. Browser CPU/RSS/device I/O unavailable.
Raw originals and source/replay receipts remain private; compact projections are derived, not additional samples.
Combined native fitting sample with 53ms elapsed is retained; no outlier removal or tail claim.
Balanced actual predeclared harness used shuffle-swarm-v1, rather than illustrative balanced-revision-v1 in initial design; no seed search/retry.

decisions.exact: retain narrow current-path unstratified ranges; upstream/suffix fusion priority and terminal admission errors preserved
decisions.mixed: retain narrow auto/uniform-before-final-FY elision; earlier explicit FY remains; parser-capacity/fit limitation explicit
decisions.adaptive: reject/no retained code: no demonstrated native complete-job gain; no WASI inference
decisions.balanced: defer/no retained code: predefined all-three-paired primary falsifier failed and fitting control median slower; no size selector

validation_status: Independent integrated source reviews and final committed-head local CI are recorded separately; benchmark success is not delivery approval.
